title: Chapter 131
text:
"What the f * ck!"

"What happened?"

"Why did the favorability drop?"

The members of Kill-all were confused. They immediately turned around and saw Han Xiao looking at them coldly. Now, they knew what was going on. They hurriedly moved to the side, shocked.

SliceYouUp was frustrated. He did not know that his actions would make Black Phantom unhappy. Wasn't it normal for guilds to monopolize resources in the game? Why was this NPC so smart?

All the favorability points that he had earned over the past few days were gone, and he even lost a lot of money.

The surrounding members looked at him with resentment. SliceYouUp regretted his actions. He felt that his position as the guild leader had decreased by one point. It was very embarrassing, so he could only leave with his people.

The surrounding players were confused. They did not understand why Kill-all, who was so arrogant just a moment ago, suddenly shrunk.

Jade Green Sky thought that Kill-all was afraid of Sky Territory and was confused.

What is going on? When did my guild become so strong?

Without anyone blocking the way, the players finally noticed the prize-pool mission. They finally understood the purpose of Kill-all and were filled with righteous indignation.

"What the f * ck, they want to monopolize it!"

"So despicable!"

After a while of verbal attacks, the players' attention was attracted to the prize-pool mission. One by one, ten by ten, and ten by a hundred, the players swarmed to accept the mission.

The prize-pool had accumulated to more than 500,000, which was an astronomical figure that was completely unimaginable to the current players. Just looking at this number made them so excited that they could not breathe.

Only the top five players could get the prize. The ranking was determined by the damage output. Compared to the number of participants, the probability of getting five slots was undoubtedly very small.

However, the common problem of humans was that they all thought that they were very lucky and had a one-in-a-million fantasy. What if they won? This was the same as the three biggest illusions in life: "She likes me", "I can kill her", and "This is in the bag".

The current players were not even LV 10, so their combat power was very low. However, the advantage was that they were not afraid of death. With a pistol, they had some lethality. At least, they could use the number of people to share the firepower. This was what Han Xiao thought when he issued the mission.

…

Big Horn Mountain Forest was vast. The Dark Net's intelligence was very good. It marked the exact route of the Germinal Organization's evacuation.

Everyone arrived at the booby-trapped location. The players spread out and formed teams to ambush. Among them, the closed beta players were very popular. Naturally, the guilds had the most advantage.

Teaming up was the general trend. Everyone believed that it was impossible to get a place in the rankings by relying on the damage output of a single person.

Maple Moon was a little depressed. Most of the players had their own groups. She was one step too late and couldn't find anyone to form a group with.

Seeing this, Han Xiao stopped Maple Moon. He took out a modified sniper rifle and a few sniper magazines and handed them to Maple Moon. "I'll lend you this gun. You stay by my side."

Maple Moon covered her mouth in surprise. She felt that this was the benefit of triggering a hidden quest, but when she looked at the attributes of the sniper rifle, she was immediately troubled. The sniper rifle required Level 1 [Sniper] to be at Level 1.

"But I don't know how to use it." Maple Moon pouted.

"Han Xiao wants to teach you [Snipe]. Would you like to spend 2,000 EXP to learn it?"

This was the sniper skill that Han Xiao did not release for the players to learn. Maple Moon felt a huge shock in her heart and agreed immediately.

Since Maple Moon was worth nurturing, Han Xiao would naturally treat her more favorably. That's right, this was called an inside job. The other players were not convinced? Ha, hold it in! In this materialistic society, those without children had no right to speak!

…

The wind blew through the forest, rustling.

The ambushing players were nervous and excited. It was the first time for many of them to participate in a battle.

Jade Green Sky led the members of Sky Territory to hide in the forest. He was determined to get into the top three of the prize-pool mission. He thought to himself, Our biggest competitor should be Kill-all. The first place should be between us and Kill-all.

On the other side, SliceYouUp was still brooding over the fact that Han Xiao's favorability had plummeted. However, the mission still had to be completed. He looked at the dejected members and said, "Don't think so much. Finish the mission first. Don't let the people of Sky Territory get ahead of us."

The passing time was like a sharp knife, making the atmosphere more and more solemn.

Han Xiao took out the information from the Dark Net and looked at it one last time. There were two combat-type executive officers in this batch of retreating troops, Freier and Seiberi. Both of them used to serve in the same country's elite forces. They were around LV 30 and were no threat to him at all.

Boom! Boom!

The sound of engines came from afar. The Germinal Organization's armed forces appeared in the electromagnetic scanning scope of the sniper rifle.

Han Xiao's eyes focused, and his entire aura suddenly became ethereal.

Maple Moon, who was lying on the ground with a sniper rifle, suddenly felt as if Han Xiao had disappeared. He was right in front of her, but she could not sense him. This made her feel very uncomfortable.

You have entered [Stealth] state. + 8% DEX. Your next attack will result in a Cheap Shot effect.

You have entered [Hold Your Breath] state. + 15% damage of your next attack.

[Night Stalker] gave Han Xiao many stealth skills. Together with Burning Will, this shot would make anyone pregnant.

In the past, there was Xiao Li's Flying Dagger. Today, there was Xiao Han's One Shot.

This shot was prepared for the executive officers. Han Xiao held his breath like a patient hunter.

The retreating troops of the Germinal Organization entered the area where the traps were laid. They were immediately shocked by the traps on the ground and fell into deep confusion. Was this a trap?

If it was not a trap, how ferocious were the beasts here? If it was a trap, who would be stupid enough to use traps on an armed force? Furthermore, it was so obvious.

Freier was the commander. He felt that something was not right and said through the walkie-talkie, "Be careful, there may be an ambush here. Minesweepers, go."

The troops slowed down their advance. The minesweepers with metal detectors on their backs walked at the front to check for mines.

The organization had moved a lot of bases, and many troops had been intercepted. The enemy was not only the Six Nations, but there were also enemies who wanted to take advantage of them. When the Germinal Organization was strong, these enemies did not dare to do anything. Now that there was an opportunity to take advantage of them, they became arrogant.

Freier and Seiberi had been attacked on the way, so they were on high alert.

"Beep, beep, beep." The metal detectors lit up in red, indicating that there were mines underground. At the same time, the scouts also found traces of human activity.

"There is an ambush ahead." Freier's face darkened.

While the Germinal troops were scouting the mines, the players hiding in the forest also saw the enemy. The fully-armed Germinal troops and armored vehicles looked very intimidating and were not to be trifled with. However, when they thought about the huge reward pool of the mission, the players could not hold back anymore. A group of players immediately jumped out and opened fire from afar with their pistols.

The Germinal Organization troops wanted to instinctively lie down to avoid the bullets, but they realized that the enemy's bullets were almost flying into outer space.

"Counterattack!"

The Germinal Organization troops immediately opened fire. The sound of submachine guns rang out, and the machine guns of the armored vehicles roared. Some of the heavy firepower players fired their howitzers.
